verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only that Recruitee can schedule events and sync a work calendar. Nothing shows calendar invites carrying an interview kit or scorecard, or automated reminders for interviewers to submit feedback. Calendar sync is an adjacent scheduling feature, not the interviewer-preparation capability this story describes.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviewers get prepared automatically — calendar invites carry the interview kit, the scorecard, and reminders to submit feedback
